items.title: Aryna Sabalenka powers her way into third round of U.S. Open in just 53 minutes
items.summary: The top-seeded Sabalenka overwhelmed Polina Iatcenko 6-1, 6-1 in 53 minutes, putting on a power-hitting display that made it seem her recent problems are in the past

items.title: Will 'proper captain's performance' be springboard for Shankland?
items.summary: Lawrence Shankland nets twice in Rangers' 2-1 success at Falkirk, making it back-to-back wins after a sticky start to the campaign for the new-look Ibrox side.

items.title: LA Clippers fined $30m over Leonard pay scandal
items.summary: The LA Clippers are fined $30m by the NBA for violating salary rules in order to funnel millions of dollars to star player Kawhi Leonard.
